title: Fix admin authentication and add order status notifications

requirements.summary: Add 'Forgot Password' or 'Reset Password' option in the admin login interface linked to the admin's mobile number for password recovery
acceptanceCriteria: Forgot Password link is visible on the admin login screen
Password reset flow is linked to mobile number 919708075648
Clear instructions are provided for password recovery

file_operations.description: Add a 'Forgot Password?' link or button below the login form in the admin credentials dialog. The link should display a help message instructing the admin to contact the mobile number 919708075648 for password reset assistance. Include clear visual styling to make the reset option easily discoverable without implementing a full automated reset flow.
